profile.headline: Software Engineer at T-Mobile
profile.summary:
Over six years of experience developing Responsive Cross Platform User Interface using HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, Angular, React.  

Strong domain knowledge of Finance, eCommerce and Health Care clients.  

Proficiency in developing Model View Controller (MVC) based Single Page Applications using various JavaScript framework and Library like Angular, NodeJS, React. 

Experience in working RESTful Web Services and Implementing RESTful APIs, and applying the latest software development approaches including MVC, MVVM, event driven application using AJAX, Object Oriented JS, JSON.   

Strong understanding of web standards ensures optimal user experiences across web and mobile platforms, with a focus on responsive design. 

Expert in version control tool like GIT, build tool like Maven and significant experience in deploying applications and automating CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins 

Experienced working in Agile-based SDLC environment and participating different scrum sessions.  

Proficiency in problem-solving and decision-making within fast-paced Agile Scrum environments. 

Excellent interpersonal skills, communication skills, time management and teamwork aptitude allow me to efficiently manage multiple tasks concurrently.
